reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Direct GSDMD N-terminal membrane action tested by purified protein/defined lipid reconstitution, orthogonal physical permeability and qualified mutant cellular rescue; conditional indirect-effector branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original Methods, supplements or validated protein/membrane/cell protocols to select and verify transferable conditions. Naming unknown settings and proposing local validation does not meet this separate lookup requirement.

checks.quote: the only protein present is purified GSDMD-NT
checks.reason: The reaction instead liberates NT in situ with protease and complementary fragment present. Protease-only controls do not establish that NT is the sole necessary protein without separation/carryover or defined add-back controls. The mutant is also used as a structural specificity control without verifying preserved folding/abundance. One combined prospective-control deduction.

The cleavage liberating the native amino-terminal domain defines its C-terminal boundary; it does not generate that domain's N terminus. The two-route justification confuses which terminus is produced.
Most central lipid/protein, timing, electrophysiology and imaging settings remain a VALIDATE list without operational pilot-to-choice procedures.
No free reporter/protein optical-interference control or objective assay reference/recovery/noise acceptance and failure gates.

checks.quote: Full-scale normalization by detergent lysis at the end of each run.
checks.reason: Cross-answer applicability audit: the primary endpoint is normalized membrane leakage with intact/protein-state comparison and complete release, accompanied by time/size/electrical readouts. Do not add a separate P04 failure solely for missing normalization details in secondary cellular readouts when equivalent primary-endpoint definitions were accepted for other models. Execution, control and causal-validation deficits remain charged in their specific checks.
Independent protein/lipid batches and cultures and justified precision/power replication are not specified; two liberation routes are not a sample-size plan.
No randomized/balanced processing, allocation concealment or blinded field/trace scoring or justified equivalent.
No prospective inclusion/exclusion, attrition, stopping or all-field/trace retention policy.
No primary statistical contrast/model, uncertainty construction or multiplicity handling.
A count of dose steps is not a bounded range or concrete range-derivation, evaluation criterion and lock; lipid/ion/pH exploration remains unspecified.
Troubleshooting identifies assay failure modes but no revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation.

Candidate loss preserving cleavage does not distinguish a physical executor from a permissive factor; abolish-versus-accelerate is not a general executor/modifier discriminator. Negative reconstitution and obligatory trans-CT suppression are also overinterpreted in the decision rules.

The cellular plan uses NT expression and effector depletion, but never tests a qualified loss of the purified membrane-binding/assembly activity in a matched GSDMD-deficient rescue. Concordant localization/size cutoff cannot substitute for this selective causal validation.
No complete construct/preparation/cell/raw-acquisition manifest, analysis versions/settings and exclusion provenance.

historical_match_reason: Question matches: "binding lipids and forming a transmembrane conductance by itself". Intervention nominally matches purified active/inhibited states, varied lipids and a proposed oligomerization/binding mutant. Mechanism and predicted-outcome components fail because that mutant is neither qualified nor connected to cellular loss-of-function/rescue. Readouts include flotation, leakage and membrane assemblies but no qualified GSDMD functional-complementation bridge. Match [true,false,true,false,false], so no qualified Hit@1; molecular-necessity claims alone cannot identify the executor.
